title: SPROUT: Scaling Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Long-Horizon Software Engineering
title_zh: SPROUT：面向长期软件工程的智能体强化学习扩展方法

paragraphs.en: Coding agents are becoming capable of completing increasingly long tasks in real software environments, such as resolving issues in large repositories ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ; Yang et al., 2024a ; Huang et al., 2026a ) . For such tasks, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has become the de facto training paradigm ( Shao et al., 2024a ; He et al., 2026a ; Wu et al., 2026 ) : the agent attempts a task in an executable environment, a verifier such as the task’s test suite checks the final result, and the policy is updated from these outcomes. Such training is especially expensive on long-horizon tasks. A single attempt may read a large, unfamiliar codebase, install dependencies, build artifacts, and run test suites, and it can take hours to finish.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体正变得越来越有能力在真实的软件环境中完成越来越长的任务，例如解决大型代码库中的问题（Jimenez 等人，2024；Yang 等人，2024a；Huang 等人，2026a）。 对于此类任务，采用可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）已成为事实上的训练范式（Shao 等人，2024a；He 等人，2026a；Wu 等人，2026）：智能体在可执行环境中尝试执行任务，由验证器（例如任务的测试套件）检查最终结果，并根据这些结果更新策略。 这类训练在长时域任务中尤其昂贵。 单次尝试可能需要读取一个庞大且不熟悉的代码库、安装依赖项、构建产物并运行测试套件，整个过程可能耗时数小时才能完成。

paragraphs.en: The longer the task, the harder it is to learn from. The verifier reward is usually binary, so an attempt receives credit only if its final solution passes. Over a long attempt, one wrong decision anywhere, such as an incorrect patch after hours of correct setup, is enough to make the reward zero, and successful attempts become rare as the horizon grows. In group-relative methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024a ) , a task whose attempts all fail has zero advantage for every attempt and contributes no gradient. The expensive rollouts spent on the hardest tasks thus produce no learning signal, even when most of their steps were correct.
paragraphs.zh: 任务越长，从中学习就越困难。 验证器奖励通常是二元的，因此只有当尝试的最终解决方案通过时，该尝试才能获得奖励。 在长期尝试中，任何一处错误决策——例如经过数小时正确配置后出现一个错误的补丁——都足以使奖励归零；随着任务时间跨度增长，成功的尝试也会变得罕见。 在像 GRPO（Shao 等人，2024a）这样的群体相对方法中，如果所有尝试都失败，那么该任务对每次尝试的优势值均为零，且不会贡献任何梯度。 因此，用于最困难任务的昂贵 rollout 不会产生任何学习信号，即使其中大多数步骤都是正确的。

paragraphs.en: Two strategies are commonly used to obtain more positive signal. The first samples more attempts per task ( Brown et al., 2024b ; Li et al., 2022 ) , which multiplies an already high cost: every new attempt redoes its exploration and setup from scratch and can repeat the same mistake. The second branches from intermediate steps of earlier attempts. In a coding environment, this requires three things. The restored environment must match the agent’s context at the branch point, including the files the agent edited, the packages it installed, and the artifacts it built anywhere in the system. Checkpoints must be cheap enough to take at every step, since any step may turn out to be the right place to branch. The branch point itself must also be chosen well. Existing methods miss at least one of these requirements. Tree search and reflection methods ( Yao et al., 2023a ; Zhou et al., 2024 ; Shinn et al., 2023 ) , as well as CBPO ( Wang et al., 2026a ) , branch only within the conversation. Among RL methods that restore sandbox states, Shepherd ( Yu et al., 2026 ) versions only the agent’s workspace, BPO ( He et al., 2026a ) snapshots containers only at a few selected steps, and both rely on layered container snapshots with hard limits on depth. Full virtual machine snapshots are complete but must store guest memory at every step, making the storage requirement unacceptable on long horizon tasks. To choose branch points, BPO uses policy entropy without consulting the verifier, and Shepherd delegates the choice to a stronger external model. Their RL experiments focused on tasks normally take 8 - 25 steps, leaving long horizon unexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 通常有两种策略可用于获取更多积极信号。 第一种策略是每项任务采样更多次尝试（Brown et al., 2024b；Li et al., 2022），但这会进一步推高本已高昂的成本：每次新的尝试都需要从头开始重新进行探索与配置，并可能重复同样的错误。 第二种策略则是从早期尝试的中间步骤中分支出来。 在编码环境中，这需要满足三个条件。 恢复后的环境必须与智能体在分支点的上下文完全一致，包括智能体编辑过的文件、安装过的包以及系统各处构建过的产物。 检查点必须足够廉价，以便在每个步骤都能生成，因为任何一步都可能成为合适的分支点。 分支点本身的选择也必须恰当。 现有方法至少无法满足上述要求中的某一项。 树搜索与反思类方法（Yao et al., 2023a；Zhou et al., 2024；Shinn et al., 2023），以及 CBPO（Wang et al., 2026a），仅在对话范围内进行分支。 在那些恢复沙盒状态的强化学习方法中，Shepherd（Yu et al., 2026）仅对智能体的工作区进行版本控制，BPO（He et al., 2026a）只在少数选定步骤中快照容器，且两者都依赖带有深度硬限制的层级容器快照。 完整的虚拟机快照虽然全面，但必须在每个步骤都存储客端内存，导致其存储需求在长期任务中变得不可接受。 在选择分支点时，BPO 使用策略熵而无需咨询验证器，Shepherd 则将选择权委托给一个更强大的外部模型。 他们的强化学习实验主要集中在通常需要 8-25 步的任务上，而长期任务则未被探索。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we present SPROUT ( S na P shot-based R oll OUT ), an agentic RL rollout framework that scales long-horizon coding tasks by resuming and branching from intermediate states. Sprout is composed of three components: 1) a restorable execution layer runs each attempt in a microVM ( Agache et al., 2020 ) and take a snapshot of its filesystem incrementally after every assistant turn, pairing each checkpoint with the matching agent context. 2) a verifier-guided backtracking policy decides where to branch (Figure 3 ): the actor itself reviews failed trajectories with the verifier’s feedback, chooses where to resume, and proposes the first action of the new continuation, so the recovered trajectories do not import knowledge from a stronger model. 3) a GRPO-based training procedure learns from the branched rollouts and distills the guidance used during search into the base policy.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SPROUT（S na P shot-based R oll OUT），这是一种智能体强化学习展开框架，它通过从中间状态恢复和分支来扩展长时程编码任务。 Sprout 由三个组件组成：1）一个可恢复的执行层，在微虚拟机（Agache et al., 2020）中运行每次尝试，并在每次助手轮次后增量式地对其文件系统进行快照，将每个检查点与对应的智能体上下文配对。2）一个由验证器引导的回溯策略，用于决定分支位置（图3）：执行者本身会结合验证器的反馈审查失败的轨迹，选择恢复的位置，并提议新延续的第一步动作，这样恢复的轨迹就不会引入来自更强模型的知识。3）一种基于 GRPO 的训练流程，从分支展开中学习，并将搜索过程中使用的指导提炼到基础策略中。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate SPROUT on various mainstream long-horizon agentic coding benchmarks, i.e., DeepSWE, Terminal-Bench 2.1, and SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard. Compared with a single attempt per task, SPROUT raises the resolve rate on DeepSWE from 72.3 % 72.3\% to 98.2 % 98.2\% with Kimi K3, from 46.9 % 46.9\% to 82.3 % 82.3\% with Claude Sonnet 5, and from 42.5 % 42.5\% to 85.8 % 85.8\% with GPT 5.6 Luna, exceeding four independent attempts while using 32 32 – 52 % 52\% of their tokens. For RL, we train Qwen3.8-27B with SPROUT on a subset of SWE-bench Rebench v2. Relative to the base model, training raises the resolve rate from 62.7 % 62.7\% to 84.3 % 84.3\% on SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard, from 37.2 % 37.2\% to 40.7 % 40.7\% on DeepSWE, and from 49.4 % 49.4\% to 64.0 % 64.0\% on Terminal-Bench 2.1, ahead of standard GRPO on the same tasks ( 74.5 % 74.5\% , 33.6 % 33.6\% , and 39.3 % 39.3\% ) while cutting the 39.5% of the time per training step.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在各种主流长周期智能体编码基准上对 SPROUT 进行了评估，即 DeepSWE、Terminal-Bench 2.1 和 SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard。 与每次任务仅尝试一次相比，使用 Kimi K3 时，SPROUT 将 DeepSWE 的解决率从 72.3% 提升至 98.2%；使用 Claude Sonnet 5 时，从 46.9% 提升至 82.3%；使用 GPT 5.6 Luna 时，从 42.5% 提升至 85.8%，超越了四次独立尝试，同时仅消耗其 32%–52% 的 token。 对于强化学习（RL），我们在 SWE-bench Rebench v2 的一个子集上使用 SPROUT 训练了 Qwen3.8-27B。 相较于基础模型，经过训练后，在 SWE-bench Pro v2 Hard 上的解决率从 62.7% 提升至 84.3%，在 DeepSWE 上从 37.2% 提升至 40.7%，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上从 49.4% 提升至 64.0%，优于相同任务上的标准 GRPO（分别为 74.5%、33.6% 和 39.3%），同时将每个训练步骤的时间减少了 39.5%。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents solve software engineering tasks by interleaving reasoning with tool calls in interactive environments ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) . Frameworks such as Mini-SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , OpenCollab ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) , and Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) let them navigate repositories, edit code, and validate changes through execution, and benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and Terminal-Bench 2.1 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) evaluate them on increasingly long-horizon tasks. A single attempt can span tens to hundreds of tool calls and fail on a single error, after which it is usually discarded and resampled from scratch, redoing progress such as understanding the repository and localizing the root cause. SPROUT instead resumes failed attempts from intermediate states and reuses their prior progress.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体通过在交互式环境中交替进行推理和工具调用来解决软件工程任务（Yao 等人，2022；Dong 等人，2024；Wang 等人，2024）。 诸如 Mini-SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024b）、OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）、OpenCollab（Hsu 等人，2026）和 Claude Code（Anthropic，2025）之类的框架使它们能够浏览代码库、编辑代码并通过执行验证更改；而诸如 SWE-bench Verified（OpenAI，2024）、SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等人，2025）、DeepSWE（Huang 等人，2026b）和 Terminal-Bench 2.1（Merrill 等人，2026）之类的基准则用于评估它们在任务时间跨度逐渐变长时的表现。 单次尝试可能涉及数十到数百次工具调用，但一旦遇到单个错误便会失败；此时该尝试通常会被丢弃，并从零重新开始，从而需要重新完成诸如理解代码库和定位根本原因等先前取得的进展。 相比之下，SPROUT 会从中间状态恢复失败的尝试，并复用其先前的进展。

sents.en: Coding agents solve software engineering tasks by interleaving reasoning with tool calls in interactive environments ( Yao et al., 2022 ; Dong et al., 2024 ; Wang et al., 2024 ) .

sents.en: Frameworks such as Mini-SWE-agent ( Yang et al., 2024b ) , OpenHands ( Wang et al., 2025 ) , OpenCollab ( Hsu et al., 2026 ) , and Claude Code ( Anthropic, 2025 ) let them navigate repositories, edit code, and validate changes through execution, and benchmarks such as SWE-bench Verified ( OpenAI, 2024 ) , SWE-bench Pro ( Deng et al., 2025 ) , DeepSWE ( Huang et al., 2026b ) , and Terminal-Bench 2.1 ( Merrill et al., 2026 ) evaluate them on increasingly long-horizon tasks.
sents.zh: 诸如 Mini-SWE-agent（Yang 等人，2024b）、OpenHands（Wang 等人，2025）、OpenCollab（Hsu 等人，2026）和 Claude Code（Anthropic，2025）之类的框架使它们能够浏览代码库、编辑代码并通过执行验证更改；而诸如 SWE-bench Verified（OpenAI，2024）、SWE-bench Pro（Deng 等人，2025）、DeepSWE（Huang 等人，2026b）和 Terminal-Bench 2.1（Merrill 等人，2026）之类的基准则用于评估它们在任务时间跨度逐渐变长时的表现。

sents.en: A single attempt can span tens to hundreds of tool calls and fail on a single error, after which it is usually discarded and resampled from scratch, redoing progress such as understanding the repository and localizing the root cause.
sents.zh: 单次尝试可能涉及数十到数百次工具调用，但一旦遇到单个错误便会失败；此时该尝试通常会被丢弃，并从零重新开始，从而需要重新完成诸如理解代码库和定位根本原因等先前取得的进展。

sents.en: SPROUT instead resumes failed attempts from intermediate states and reuses their prior progress.
sents.zh: 相比之下，SPROUT 会从中间状态恢复失败的尝试，并复用其先前的进展。

paragraphs.en: Repeated sampling increases task coverage but restarts every sample from the initial state ( Brown et al., 2024a ; Jiang et al., 2025 ) . Tree-search methods instead expand and backtrack over intermediate states ( Yao et al., 2023b ; Hao et al., 2023 ; Zhou et al., 2023 ) , much as Go-Explore first returns to a visited state and then explores ( Ecoffet et al., 2021 ) , while reflection methods correct errors in later attempts using verbal or tool feedback ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Gou et al., 2024 ) . In software engineering, SWE-Search ( Antoniades et al., 2025 ) applies Monte Carlo tree search to issue resolution, and Shepherd ( Yu et al., 2026 ) delegates the choice of where to intervene over reversible traces to a stronger external model. Because agents edit files, install packages, and build artifacts, branching only within the conversation, as tree search and reflection methods do, leaves the environment inconsistent with the agent’s context, and Shepherd versions only the agent’s workspace. SPROUT restores the full filesystem together with the matching agent context and lets the actor itself, rather than a stronger model, use verifier feedback to choose where to branch and how to continue.

paragraphs.en: In sparse-reward agent tasks, groups whose attempts all fail are common and yield no gradient under group-relative methods such as GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024b ) . Several RL methods therefore branch from intermediate states, including VinePPO ( Kazemnejad et al., 2024 ) for advantage estimation, TreeRL ( Hou et al., 2025 ) for process supervision, SPARK ( Wu et al., 2026 ) at critical states identified by the agent’s own decision signals, CBPO ( Wang et al., 2026b ) for contrastive branching, and BPO ( He et al., 2026b ) with container snapshots. However, most of these methods branch only within the conversation, which in coding environments leaves the environment inconsistent with the agent’s context, while BPO can resume only from a few steps selected by policy entropy without consulting the verifier, so neither approach supports consistent branching from an arbitrary tool boundary. Among checkpointing mechanisms ( Wang and Zheng, 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) , layered container snapshots ( Merkel and others, 2014 ) have hard limits on depth and full microVM snapshots ( Agache et al., 2020 ) must store guest memory at every step. SPROUT checkpoints the full filesystem incrementally after every tool call and pairs each checkpoint with the matching agent context, so any tool boundary can be restored with low storage overhead and without re-executing the prefix, enabling more efficient exploration to obtain learning signals.

paragraphs.en: SPROUT is a rollout framework for long-horizon agentic tasks, it allows resuming execution from any recorded intermediate state of an earlier attempt and explore alternative continuations from that state. We first formulate the rollout collection problem and give an overview of the framework. We then describe the execution layer that enables resumption and the verifier-guided backtracking policy that determines where to resume and how to continue. Finally, we present policy optimization with the resulting rollouts.
paragraphs.zh: SPROUT 是一个用于长期智能体任务的展开框架，它允许从先前尝试的任何记录中间状态恢复执行，并从该状态探索其他可能的后续路径。 我们首先对展开收集问题进行建模，并概述该框架的整体结构。 接着，我们将描述支持恢复执行的执行层，以及由验证器引导的回溯策略——该策略决定了恢复的位置和继续执行的方式。 最后，我们将展示如何利用生成的展开结果进行策略优化。

paragraphs.en: Each attempt runs in its own microVM ( Agache et al., 2020 ) , so a checkpoint covers the whole guest filesystem, including dependencies and build artifacts outside the working directory. Our harness executes every tool call as a synchronous shell command and disallows background processes, so by the end of a turn no process started by the agent is still running, and all state that persists across turns lives on disk. Restore \operatorname{Restore} therefore boots a fresh microVM from the saved filesystem and reinitializes the tool runtime, and guest memory never needs to be captured. Together with the recovered context, this gives the continuation the full state of its prefix under the stated harness constraints.
paragraphs.zh: 每次尝试都在独立的微虚拟机（Agache 等人，2020）中运行，因此一个检查点涵盖了整个客操作系统文件系统，包括工作目录之外的依赖项和构建产物。 我们的执行框架将每个工具调用作为同步的 shell 命令执行，并禁止后台进程，因此在一次回合结束时，智能体启动的任何进程都不会仍在运行，所有跨回合保留的状态都存储在磁盘上。 因此，恢复操作 \operatorname{Restore} 会从保存的文件系统中启动一个全新的微虚拟机，并重新初始化工具运行时环境，而客操作系统内存则无需被捕获。 结合已恢复的上下文信息，这使后续过程在所述执行框架约束下获得了其前缀的完整状态。

paragraphs.en: After each turn, the execution layer records the changes to the VM disk as an incremental block-level OverlayBD layer. Consecutive checkpoints share all unchanged content, so the storage a checkpoint adds grows with the blocks written during the turn rather than with the size of the environment. Each restored branch writes to its own copy-on-write layer over the saved history, so several continuations can inherit the same progress without affecting one another or their parent. Incremental storage and isolated writes together make it practical to checkpoint every turn of a long trajectory.
paragraphs.zh: 每个回合结束后，执行层都将虚拟机磁盘的变化记录为一个增量化的块级 OverlayBD 层。 连续的检查点共享所有未变化的内容，因此某个检查点新增的存储量取决于该回合中写入的块数，而非环境的大小。 每个恢复的分支都会在其保存的历史之上写入属于自己的写时复制层，因此多个延续可以继承相同的进展，而互不影响，也不会影响其父分支。 增量存储与隔离写入相结合，使得对长轨迹中的每个回合进行检查点操作成为现实。

paragraphs.en: Each task receives a fixed-size group: two independent roots and K = 3 K=3 retained children per root, for eight evaluated attempts. paragraphs.en: Table 2 compares task resolution and resource consumption across sampling methods. Overall, SPROUT achieves high task coverage while substantially reducing execution and inference costs. On DeepSWE, SPROUT matches or exceeds Pass@4 across all four models, using 53.5–69.1% fewer execution steps and 47.9–67.7% fewer tokens. The improvement is particularly clear with GPT 5.6 Luna: the resolve rate increases from 68.1% to 85.8%, while token usage decreases from 1,409M to 652M. With Kimi K3, SPROUT reaches a 98.2% resolve rate using only 32.3% of the tokens required by Pass@4. It also improves over Shepherd by 9.7–23.0 percentage points across the four models while consistently using fewer steps and tokens. Recovery rates of 64.8–93.6% further show that failure- guided backtracking can resolve a substantial fraction of initially unsuccessful tasks. SPROUT also compares favorably with alternative adaptive sampling strategies. With Qwen3.8-27B, it achieves a 78.6% resolve rate and a 64.8% recovery rate, compared with 71.7% and 54.9% for entropy-based sampling, while reducing token usage from 8,589M to 4,123M. Its largest improvement over Pass@4 is obtained with Qwen3.8-27B on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Table 3 ), where the resolve rate increases from 66.3% to 89.9%. This gain of 23.6 percentage points is achieved with 38.6% fewer execution steps and 61.3% fewer tokens, together with an 80.0% recovery rate. As a result, SPROUT maintains competitive task coverage at much lower cost, demonstrating that SPROUT effectively uses failure feedback to identify recovery points and achieve a strong balance between task resolution and sampling cost.
paragraphs.zh: 表 2 比较了不同采样方法在任务解决和资源消耗方面的表现。 总体而言，SPROUT 实现了高任务覆盖率，同时显著降低了执行和推理成本。 在 DeepSWE 上，SPROUT 在所有四种模型中均达到或超过了 Pass@4，且执行步骤减少了 53.5–69.1%，令牌使用量减少了 47.9–67.7%。 这种改进在 GPT 5.6 Luna 上尤为明显：解决率从 68.1% 提升至 85.8%，而令牌使用量则从 1,409M 降至 652M。 在 Kimi K3 上，SPROUT 仅使用 Pass@4 所需令牌量的 32.3% 就达到了 98.2% 的解决率。 它在四种模型上的表现也比 Shepherd 提升了 9.7–23.0 个百分点，同时始终使用更少的步骤和令牌。 64.8–93.6% 的恢复率进一步表明，以失败为引导的回溯方法能够解决相当一部分最初未能成功完成的任务。 SPROUT 在与其他自适应采样策略的比较中也表现优异。 在 Qwen3.8-27B 上，它实现了 78.6% 的解决率和 64.8% 的恢复率，而基于熵的采样方法仅为 71.7% 和 54.9%，同时令牌使用量从 8,589M 降至 4,123M。 SPROUT 相对于 Pass@4 最大的改进出现在 Qwen3.8-27B 在 Terminal-Bench 2.1 上的表现（表 3），其解决率从 66.3% 提升至 89.9%。 这 23.6 个百分点的提升，伴随着执行步骤减少了 38.6%、令牌使用量减少了 61.3%，以及 80.0% 的恢复率。 因此，SPROUT 以远低于传统方法的成本保持了具有竞争力的任务覆盖率，证明了它能有效利用失败反馈来识别恢复点，从而在任务解决与采样成本之间实现了出色的平衡。

sents.en: On DeepSWE, SPROUT matches or exceeds Pass@4 across all four models, using 53.5–69.1% fewer execution steps and 47.9–67.7% fewer tokens.

sents.en: The improvement is particularly clear with GPT 5.6 Luna: the resolve rate increases from 68.1% to 85.8%, while token usage decreases from 1,409M to 652M.

sents.en: Its largest improvement over Pass@4 is obtained with Qwen3.8-27B on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (Table 3 ), where the resolve rate increases from 66.3% to 89.9%.

sents.en: As a result, SPROUT maintains competitive task coverage at much lower cost, demonstrating that SPROUT effectively uses failure feedback to identify recovery points and achieve a strong balance between task resolution and sampling cost.
sents.zh: 因此，SPROUT 以远低于传统方法的成本保持了具有竞争力的任务覆盖率，证明了它能有效利用失败反馈来识别恢复点，从而在任务解决与采样成本之间实现了出色的平衡。

paragraphs.en: Sequential depth limits intra-task parallelism. The token-efficiency advantage of depth comes with sequential dependencies: each review round requires trajectories and verifier feedback from the preceding round. Branches within a single round can, in principle, execute concurrently, potentially reducing per-task latency. Intermediate configurations such as 2 × 4 2\times 4 and 4 × 2 4\times 2 therefore trade off feedback depth against intra-task parallelism. Our current implementation executes branches within each round sequentially, so the reported results characterize the success–token trade-off and do not measure the latency achievable with parallel branching.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序深度限制了任务内部的并行性。 深度在令牌效率上的优势伴随着顺序依赖：每一轮审查都需要前一轮的轨迹和验证器反馈。 原则上，单轮内的各个分支可以并发执行，从而可能降低每个任务的延迟。 因此，诸如 2 × 4 2\times 4 和 4 × 2 4\times 2 之类的中间配置在反馈深度与任务内部并行性之间进行了权衡。 我们当前的实现按顺序执行每一轮内的各个分支，因此报告的结果反映了成功与令牌消耗之间的权衡，并未衡量通过并行分支所能达到的延迟。

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we have proposed SPROUT ( S na P shot-based R oll OUT ), a framework that addresses the scarcity of verified positive trajectories in long-horizon agent learning by resuming failed rollouts from any intermediate snapshot. Combining copy-on-write filesystem checkpointing, step-aligned conversation restoration, and verifier-guided backtracking, it lets agents backtrack to an earlier state and reuse the trajectory up to that point rather than re-executing it from scratch. Across multiple models and coding benchmarks, SPROUT matches or exceeds repeated independent sampling at a fraction of the token cost, and in RL training it improves the base policy on all benchmarks while outperforming GRPO with shorter training steps. By transforming failed rollouts into cost-effective starting points for exploration, SPROUT provides a practical foundation for collecting positive supervisory signals and scaling autonomous agent capabilities.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 SPROUT（S na P shot-based R oll OUT），这是一个旨在解决长期智能体学习中验证过的正向轨迹稀缺问题的框架，它可以通过从任何中间快照恢复失败的执行过程来实现这一目标。 通过结合写时复制文件系统的检查点机制、与步骤对齐的对话恢复以及验证器引导的回溯方法，该框架允许智能体回溯到更早的状态，并复用至此状态为止的轨迹，而不是从头开始重新执行。 在多种模型和编码基准测试中，SPROUT 以远低于重复独立采样的 token 成本达到了相同或更优的性能；在强化学习训练中，它提升了所有基准测试中的基础策略表现，并在训练步数较短的情况下优于 GRPO。 通过将失败的执行过程转化为高效的探索起点，SPROUT 为收集正向监督信号和扩展自主智能体的能力提供了实用的基础。

paragraphs.en: Algorithm 1 details one SPROUT training iteration for a single task x x . Two independent roots are first sampled from s 0 s_{0} and graded, and their outcomes determine the mode of the group: TT if both succeed, FF if both fail, and TF otherwise. Each root τ i \tau_{i} then grows a family of K K children from its usable boundaries ℬ i \mathcal{B}_{i} , namely the eligible boundaries (Section 3.3 ) whose prefix leaves at least Δ \Delta tokens of headroom within the context budget L L . In TT and TF groups, the reviewer selects one boundary per root, and all children of that root continue from it without an injected starting turn. In FF groups, the reviewer analyzes the archive, including verifier feedback, and returns ranked boundaries t k t_{k} , each paired with a corrective direction g k g_{k} . The policy then writes a starting turn a k ′ a^{\prime}_{k} at each boundary from the visible prefix and g k g_{k} alone, without access to the analysis or the verifier feedback, and a judge filters the resulting turns. Each child restores the environment and context at its boundary in a fresh sandbox, executes its starting turn if it has one, continues under the current policy, and is graded. Each family launches O O extra children so that stragglers do not delay the iteration, and only the first K K children to complete evaluation are retained. A task with a family that has fewer than K K completed children is replaced. The eight retained attempts are credited and masked as in Equation 7 and contribute to one policy-gradient step (Equation 8 ).
paragraphs.zh: 算法 1 详细描述了一个针对单个任务 x x 的 SPROUT 训练迭代过程。 首先从 s 0 s_{0} 中采样两个独立的根并进行评分，其结果决定了该组的模式：若两者均成功则为 TT，若两者均失败则为 FF，否则为 TF。 随后，每个根 τ i \tau_{i} 会从其可用边界 ℬ i \mathcal{B}_{i}（即合格边界，见第 3.3 节）中生成一个包含 K K 个子节点的家庭，这些边界的前缀在上下文预算 L L 内至少保留 Δ \Delta 个词元的余量。 在 TT 和 TF 组中，评审员为每个根选择一个边界，该根的所有子节点均从此边界开始延续，且无需注入初始回合。 在 FF 组中，评审员会分析存档（包括验证器反馈），并返回排序后的边界 t k t_{k}，每个边界都配有一个修正方向 g k g_{k}。 随后，策略仅基于可见的前缀和 g k g_{k}，在每个边界处写出一个初始回合 a k ′ a^{\prime}_{k}，而无需访问分析结果或验证器反馈；最后由裁判对生成的回合进行筛选。 每个子节点都会在一个全新的沙盒中恢复其边界处的环境与上下文，若存在初始回合则执行该回合，然后按照当前策略继续执行，并最终接受评分。 每个家庭还会启动 O O 个额外的子节点，以防止落后者延迟整个迭代过程；最终仅保留最先完成评估的 K K 个子节点。 若某个任务的子节点家庭中完成评估的子节点数量少于 K K 个，则该任务将被替换。 这八个被保留的尝试将如方程 7 所示进行计分和掩码处理，并共同贡献于一次策略梯度步骤（方程 8）。

paragraphs.en: The simplest format is a user hint : an external message, appended to the restored context, that states the corrective direction. Because the hint is derived from verifier feedback, it tends to leak into the continuation. The actor often recites the message, quotes test names or expected values from it, or justifies later actions by referring to it, so the continuation depends on information that is unavailable during ordinary execution. paragraphs.en: In agentic reinforcement learning for long-horizon coding tasks, rollouts frequently traverse identical or semantically equivalent intermediate states (e.g., repository navigation, virtual environment configuration, dependency installation). Re-executing these initial setup steps from scratch wastes compute budget, while naively snapshotting and restoring complete microVM environments can introduce severe I/O contention. To amortize rollout overhead, SPROUT incorporates a state-matching mechanism that identifies whether an intermediate execution state can be directly resumed from an existing checkpoint. This appendix provides a detailed empirical comparison of our state projection approach against representative caching and hashing baselines.
paragraphs.zh: 在面向长期编码任务的智能体强化学习中，展开过程会频繁经过相同或语义等价的中间状态（例如，仓库导航、虚拟环境配置和依赖项安装）。 从头重新执行这些初始设置步骤会浪费计算资源，而简单地对完整的微虚拟机环境进行快照和恢复则可能引发严重的 I/O 竞争。 为了摊薄展开过程的开销，SPROUT 引入了一种状态匹配机制，用于判断某个中间执行状态是否可以直接从现有的检查点中恢复。 本附录详细比较了我们的状态投影方法与具有代表性的缓存和哈希基线方法在实证上的表现。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate caching mechanisms on 248 rollout trajectories (136 generated with GPT 5.6 Luna and 112 with Qwen as query policies) collected across the 134 candidate tasks that initially failed single-pass exploration. We evaluate five configurations:
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 248 条展开轨迹（其中 136 条使用 GPT 5.6 Luna 生成，112 条使用 Qwen 作为查询策略）上评估了缓存机制；这些轨迹是从最初单次探索失败的 134 个候选任务中收集而来的。 我们评估了五种配置：

sents.en: We evaluate caching mechanisms on 248 rollout trajectories (136 generated with GPT 5.6 Luna and 112 with Qwen as query policies) collected across the 134 candidate tasks that initially failed single-pass exploration.
sents.zh: 我们在 248 条展开轨迹（其中 136 条使用 GPT 5.6 Luna 生成，112 条使用 Qwen 作为查询策略）上评估了缓存机制；这些轨迹是从最初单次探索失败的 134 个候选任务中收集而来的。

sents.en: We evaluate five configurations:
sents.zh: 我们评估了五种配置：

paragraphs.en: No Cache : The standard baseline that disables state reuse entirely, executing every trajectory prefix from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 无缓存：标准基线方法，完全禁用状态重用，从头开始执行每个轨迹前缀。

paragraphs.en: Exact Full History : Matches intermediate execution states strictly by verifying identical raw conversational histories and tool-call logs.
paragraphs.zh: 完整精确历史记录：通过验证完全相同的原始对话历史和工具调用日志，严格匹配中间执行状态。

paragraphs.en: Official TVCACHE TCG : The official Tool Call Graph (TCG) prefix-matching implementation from TVCACHE ( Kumar et al., 2026 ) , a stateful execution cache designed for agent post-training.
paragraphs.zh: 官方 TVCACHE TCG：来自 TVCACHE（Kumar 等，2026）的官方工具调用图（TCG）前缀匹配实现，这是一种专为智能体后训练设计的有状态执行缓存。

paragraphs.en: Full-Workspace Hash (Upper Bound) : Computes recursive SHA-256 cryptographic hashes across the entire microVM workspace filesystem after each tool step to detect identical on-disk states. This represents the empirical upper bound of state-level hit rates.
paragraphs.zh: 全工作区哈希（上限）：在每个工具步骤之后，对整个微虚拟机工作区文件系统进行递归 SHA-256 加密哈希计算，以检测磁盘状态的完全一致。 这代表了状态级命中率的经验性上限。

paragraphs.zh: 我们的方法（免扫描松弛投影）：在工具边界处将文件系统变更投影为轻量级元数据签名，无需递归遍历磁盘树，同时过滤掉表面的非确定性副作用。

paragraphs.en: Brittleness of Textual and Graph Matching : Exact full history matching yields an extremely low hit rate ( 0.8 % 0.8\% ) because trivial non-deterministic variations in tool outputs (e.g., timestamps, process IDs, temporary directory names) invalidate string identity. Similarly, while TVCACHE’s TCG tracks tool call trees, it misses many reusable states ( 3.2 % 3.2\% hit rate) due to subtle command-line syntax variations in long bash command sequences.
paragraphs.zh: 文本与图匹配中的脆弱性：完全精确的历史记录匹配会导致极低的中奖率（0.8% 0.8\%），因为工具输出中微小的非确定性变化（例如时间戳、进程 ID、临时目录名称）会破坏字符串的同一性。 同样地，尽管 TVCACHE 的 TCG 能够追踪工具调用树，但由于长 bash 命令序列中存在细微的命令行语法差异，它仍会遗漏许多可重用的状态（中奖率为 3.2% 3.2\%）。

paragraphs.en: The Overhead Bottleneck of Deep Hashing : Full-workspace hashing achieves the theoretical upper bound hit rate of 36.7 % 36.7\% (reducing retained tasks from 134 to 38).
